test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
'U + V' means 'U is the brother of V'

'U × V' 'U is the husband of V', and

'U ÷ V' means 'U is the mother of V'.

If 'Y × X ÷ R + N × P ÷ S + M', then which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: N is the father of M
S is the son of R
X is the mother of P
Y is the mother of N
